notes.title: Patch 1.3
notes.notes:
Good afternoon everyone! It's been a while, but the [b]Knuckle Sandwich 1.3 Update[/b] is out now. It features a heap of bug fixes and a few QOL updates that speed up the progression of the game substantially.

Update via Steam to play. Thanks for reading!

Here's a list of what's new:
[list]
[*] Added area in Arcade where you can replay certain minigames
[*] Added more items to late-Chapter #5 shop
[*] Less enemies appear in normal playthroughs across the board
[*] Moved Fire Extinguisher to speed up Chapter #4 story progression
[*] Added colours and patterns to the warp pads to make it a little easier to navigate
[*] Adjusted layout of Apricot Maze to make it faster to navigate
[*] Adjusted layout of Lost Beach to make it faster to navigate
[*] Added an extra Dolus to make navigating the cruise ship a little faster
[*] Made some Skills a little better
[*] Made the torch a little stronger
[*] Made it so you can toss Key Items if they are still in your inventory after they're meant to be used up 
[*] Minor dialogue adjustments
[*] 
[*] 
[*] Fixed Naps & Snusan textbox in Chapter #5
[*] Fixed depth issue in Apricot Maze
[*] Fixed depth issue in Grouse Gully
[*] Fixed dialogue issue in Error Zone
[*] Fixed collision issue in Error Zone
[*] Fixed issue where removing Soup from inventory would overwrite Protag's item
[*] Fixed issue with trading Arcade Token and Leotard
[*] Fixed issue where Pineapple Bats would disappear when running from battle
[*] Fixed issue where Signed Photo wouldn't turn up in Other Pocket even if it said it did
[*] Fixed issue where an item from North City would disappear when leaving the room
[*] Fixed issue with detecting repeat moves during Chapter #5 boss fight
[*] Fixed issue where healing items could be repeated during Chapter #5 boss
[*] Fixed some typos...
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 1.2.6
notes.notes:
Hey everyone, it's the Other Pocket update! 

By updating the game, you'll get access to a whole new item slot. What will you put in there? What will you take out? It's up to you!

Here is the change list for **Version 1.2.6**:
[list]
[*] Added other pocket to inventory screen.
[*] Increased benefits of hold items.
[*] Increased Pocket Puppy damage output.
[*] Added hold item effect for pins.
[*] Added visual indicator of screenshot being saved.
[*] Added level increase to late-game party members during regular difficulty runs.
[*] Balance changes to party members.
[*] Fixed issue with end credits screen.
[*] Added Bagel to end credits.
[*] Fixed oversight relating to Leotard and Arcade Token.
[*] Adjusted how save data is handled.
[*] Fixed save data error when changing settings from title screen.
[*] Fixed bug during certain status effect skills.
[*] Fixed bug where party members would no longer receive EXP after Protag reaches max level.
[/list]


There has been a major buff to almost every hold item. I am very dedicated to getting things feeling just right, so I am taking note of how people are playing Knuckle Sandwich. 

Please update ASAP before continuing your progress!




PS. Feel free to join our [url=https://discord.gg/knux]Discord server[/url]! It's a very chill place to keep up to date with the game while hanging out with a cool community.

notes.title: Patch 1.2.5
notes.notes:
Hey everyone! I have just published a new patch that fixes a few of the issues that popped up over the last few days. 

Here are the details:
[list]
[*] Balance changes to regular enemies
[*] Fixed bug where certain items would be usable in battle
[*] Fixed bug relating to Big Scrib
[*] Added monster room
[*] Fixed crash during certain shmup minigames
[*] Fixed audio bug in some areas
[*] Fixed some collisions in some late game areas
[*] A few typos...........
[/list]
 

Please update to [b]Version 1.2.5[/b] before continuing! Additionally, if you are planning to continue your PC save on a new device (PC [i]or[/i] Steamdeck), make sure you run the game on the original device after updating. Otherwise there is the possibility of save files being wiped!

Thanks.

notes.title: Patch 1.2.3
notes.notes:
Good afternoon everyone, I have just uploaded an update to the game. Please update to Version 1.2.3 to continue your Knuckle Sandwich adventure. Here's what's new:

[list]
[*] Added new way of handling save files.
[*] Fixed issue when using Auto Fight option during Chapter 2 tutorial.
[*] Fixed incorrect text in Chapter 6.
[*] Fixed crash when viewing using certain non-damaging skills with animations turned off.
[*] Fixed crash during Math Magic.
[*] Fixed audio issue in Statues.
[*] Fixed missing phone call dialogue.
[*] Fixed issue in sliding puzzle late game.
[*] Fixed visual error in late-game Skill.
[*] Fixed an egg-related problem.
[*] Removed option to view Kickstarter credits early.
[/list]

As you may note, I have added a new way of handling save files. The game will now create "savefile.ini" in its install folder from this version onward. You will be able to use this file to move save data between devices. I will be using this to test cloud saves in the future, we just gotta make sure it's working correctly beforehand. I do not recommend messing with this file if you do not know what you are doing!


Thanks heaps!

notes.title: Patch 1.2.0
notes.notes:
Hello again! I have done yet another update to fix the problems that were affecting some players. Here are the changes below:

[list]
[*] 
[*] Increased window for landing hits during Circle Attack.
[*] Fixed bug where a Steam Achievement was incorrectly given at the wrong time.
[*] Fixed some item names displaying incorrectly in the PC.
[*] Fixed bug where certain hold item stops you from being Weird.
[*] Adjusted difficulty of shoot 'em up sections.
[*] Fixed infinite leotards. :~(
[*] Adjusted difficulty of Jank Attack.
[*] Fixed bug with one of Mystery's variants.
[*] Fixed a softlock from Chapter 3 puzzle and reduced difficulty.
[*] Fixed a bug where leaving a certain area in Chapter 5 would cause the game to softlock.
[*] Fixed an issue where you were able to enter a location early in Chapter 6.
[*] Reduced background detail for enemy introduced in Chapter 6.
[*] Removed overworld puzzle in Chapter 6.
[*] Adjusted difficulty of all puzzles in Chapter 6.
[*] Reduced puzzle difficulty in Chapter 7.
[*] Resolved controller issue in Chapter 7 fight.
[*] Fixed an issue where save files were bugged if the game is closed during the end credits. 
[*] Fixed crash late game when visiting a character in their house.
[*] Fixed late game item crashing the game when consumed.
[*] Added option to see Kickstarter backer credits again via the in-game arcade.
[*] Additional item storage PCs added to overworld locations.
[/list]

Thanks again for playing this game. I strongly advice everyone to update ASAP to have a smoother experience while playing. As always, you can confirm your version number by looking at the bottom-right side of the load screen.

Andy

notes.title: Balance Patch 1.1.1
notes.notes:
Hello! Thank you again for playing Knuckle Sandwich. I have been hard at work since launch paying attention to feedback and solving the small issues that turn up. I have just uploaded a patch to help smooth things out even more. Here are the notes:

[b]Update 1.1.1[/b]

[list]
[*] Fixed issue where wrong controller buttons were displaying for battle minigames.
[*] Adjusted party member damage output.
[*] Removed obstacle in Chapter 3 dungeon softlocking the game.
[*] Fixed softlock from certain minigames completing.
[*] Chapter 5 enemy balance adjustment.
[*] Chapter 5 unique boss segment difficulty adjustment.
[*] Fixed bug where you were unable to sell items in Chapter 6 store.
[*] Adjusted difficulty of Chapter 7 puzzles.
[*] Fixed cave shop softlock.
[*] Fixed hold item not doing what it says it does.
[*] Fixed missing dialogue.
[*] Fixed issue late in the game where cutscene would be left hanging if Simplify VFX was turned on.
[*] Increased number of item PCs across the game.
[/list]


Before playing any further, please update your copy of Knuckle Sandwich. 

Thanks again.

Andy

notes.title: Day One Patch
notes.notes:

Here's what was fixed:

[b]Update 1.0.7 [/b]

[list]
[*] Fixed Protag's skill damage output.
[*] Added alternate VSYNC settings.
[*] Added little symbols to the Chapter 2 puzzles for extra readability.
[*] Removed obstacle in Chapter 3 dungeon softlocking the game.
[*] Fixed Odd Bracer sfx bug.
[*] Fixed bug where the game would occasionally crash after the Chapter 4 boss.
[*] Fixed crash when exiting north of South City.

Thanks for playing, everyone!
